Sam T.: Go (net/http):
```go
package main
import (
  "bytes"
  "fmt"
  "net/http"
  "os"
  "io/ioutil"
)
func main(){
  url := "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate"
  body := []byte(`{"model":"small-test","input":"hello"}`)
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", url, bytes.NewBuffer(body))
  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
  req.Header.Set("traceparent", "00-6f7a6f7a6f7a6f7a6f7a6f7a6f7a6f7a-00-01")
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
  client := &http.Client{Timeout: 6 * 1e9} // 6s
  resp, err := client.Do(req)
  if err != nil { fmt.Println("err:", err); return }
  defer resp.Body.Close()
  b, _ := ioutil.ReadAll(resp.Body)
  fmt.Println(resp.StatusCode, resp.Header.Get("x-request-id"))
  fmt.Println(string(b))
}
```
